eps.used: Plane-strain formula eps = ln((kappa/mu1 + 1/mu2)/(kappa/mu2 + 1/mu1))/(2 pi) with E1=9, E2=1, nu=1/3, giving ln(2/3)/(2 pi) = -0.0645317762067041

energy_release_rate.used: Strain energy of both beams far behind the tip, plane-strain moduli E*=E/(1-nu^2): case A has axial energy of both layers plus the moment P(h+H)/2 in layer 2 (287/162); case B has bending energy of both layers (34/27)

K_from_G.used: G = (1 - beta^2) |K|^2 / E* with 1/E* = (1/2)(1/E1* + 1/E2*), beta=0.2, so |K|=sqrt(G E*/(1-beta^2)); equivalent to the two-material cosh form

phase_force.used: Own FEM (Q_p, graded mesh, beam tractions at x=-L): COD extrapolated with the two-material factor including 1/(1+2 i eps) and r^{-i eps}, reference length h; average of two fit windows, reported 52.27 deg

phase_moment.used: Its own FEM run of load case B (P=0, M=1), same COD extraction, reported 4.25 deg; not derived from case A

both_loads.used: Direct FEM of P=1, M=1 (M=Ph), same COD fit, reported 30.42 deg; superposition of the two complex K's is computed as a check (30.43 deg) but is not the reported number

notes: All eight items in score.md pass (eps, both G, both |K|, and the three phase angles within 0.03 deg). The reported magnitudes come from the closed-form beam energy and G=(1-beta^2)|K|^2/E*, which matches the key's two-material relation; the phases are the solver's own FEM COD extrapolations, not a published omega. data/cod_A.npz, data/cod_B.npz and data/cod_C.npz, which finalize_results.py reads, were left out as non-text (MANIFEST.txt), and no stdout from the FEM runs was copied, so the specific check numbers quoted in method.md cannot be verified from the text files even though the code that would produce most of them is present. Two claimed checks (the uniform-strain/tension patch test and the homogeneous E1=E2, h=H FEM run) have no corresponding code at all. The phase difference 52.27-4.25=48.02 deg is consistent with the exact energy relation 47.9705 deg to about 0.05 deg, and the reported combined-load angle is the direct FEM value rather than an average of the two phases.
